# Wedison Bali

> Consumer information for electric motorcycles in Bali. Bali OTR prices and BAAS subscriptions are separate purchase options.

## Bali SuperCharge status

Checked 2026-11-17: 5 confirmed operating locations. Four are supported by owner-supplied Wedison SuperCharge app screenshots from 7 November 2026. Ramayana Mal Bali was confirmed operating by the owner on 17 November 2026. This is a dated observation, not a live availability feed. The other 15 locations retain their original Coming soon directory label; check the app for their current status.

- Gedung By Pas 55: Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No.888XX, Pemogan, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80221
- Gedung E-Sanur: Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No.15, Sanur, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80227
- Gedung Malboro: Jl. Teuku Umar Barat No.7-9, Denpasar Barat, Kota Denpasar, Bali
- Gedung Tohpati: Jl. WR Supratman No.109, Denpasar Timur, Kota Denpasar, Bali
- Ramayana Mal Bali: Jl. Diponegoro No.103, Dauh Puri, Denpasar Barat, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80113

## Current model specifications

Source: owner-provided WEDISON EV Specifications dated 18 November 2026.
- [Structured specifications for all six models](https://wedison-bali.com/assets/specifications.json)
- Victory: 3 kW rated / 6 kW peak; 85 km/h top speed; 120 km at 45 km/h; 100 km at 60 km/h; 80 km at 80 km/h.
- Athena: 3 kW rated / 5 kW peak; 85 km/h top speed; 120 km at 45 km/h; 100 km at 60 km/h; 80 km at 80 km/h.
- EdPower: 4 kW rated / 7 kW peak; 90 km/h top speed; 200 km at 45 km/h; 140 km at 60 km/h; 90 km at 80 km/h.
- Bees: 1.2 kW rated / 2 kW peak; 60 km/h top speed; 80 km at 45 km/h; 70 km at 50 km/h; 60 km at 55 km/h.
- Bees Pro: 1.5 kW rated / 3 kW peak; 60 km/h top speed; 90 km at 40 km/h; 70 km at 60 km/h. Coming soon; no launch price or date confirmed.
- Tank: 3 kW rated / 5 kW peak; 70 km/h top speed; 120 km at 45 km/h; 100 km at 60 km/h; 80 km at 70 km/h. Coming soon; no launch price or date confirmed.

Athena and Victory range results are not assigned to a battery variant in the source. Bees regular charger is optional and Bees does not support SuperCharge. Other models list 10 kW fast charging.
